messages:
tara: Trying to get a minimal LangChain example into the Next starter that uses the SDKclient and llm wrapper. Hitting confusing TypeScript types in the SDK adapter for Agents. Anyone done a clean LlamaIndex-style agent + retriever flow with our TS SDK?

noah: We had a samples spike last quarter. The adapter types were intentionally permissive (any) but that caused friction. What's the compile error?

tara: Error:

```
node_modules/redwood-sdk/llm.d.ts(45,14): error TS2345: Argument of type '{ tools: any[]; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'AgentConfig'.
  Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'tools' does not exist in type 'AgentConfig'.
```

tara: My quick hack was to `// @ts-ignore` but that's not great for a sample.

lee: On the SDK side we recently introduced a stricter AgentConfig for the new structured-tooling API. For LangChain compatibility we can offer an `AgentConfigCompat` union that allows `tools`. I'll open an issue and PR.

ci-bot: CI: examples/next-langchain-llamaindex build failed on node 18 with TypeScript errors. See job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/98765

noah: Low-friction path for samples: ship JS-only starter that imports the SDK runtime JS (no types) and a TS version that imports typed helpers. For now the starter's README should show both options.

lee: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/892 - adds AgentConfigCompat + test coverage for LangChain adapter.

docs-team: Heads-up: we'll update the quickstart + examples docs to reference the compatibility layer but also add a note that the Types-first API is preferred for new code.

tara: Great. Also small DX ask: add a short snippet for local eval harness usage in the starter (how to run evals against the local Redwood Dedicated dev image). People keep asking in support.

noah: Snippet suggestion for README: 

```bash
# start local dedicated image
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/dedicated:dev
# run eval harness
yarn eval --config examples/next-langchain/eval.config.json --target http://localhost:8080
```

lee: Also adding a tiny script `examples/next-langchain/scripts/run-local-eval.sh` that wraps the command and sets env vars.

ci-bot: Note: re-run job after merge.

noah: Nice collaboration. Once the PR merges we'll bump the examples submodule and cut a small patch release of the quickstart starter.

lee: Ping me if you want help migrating your sample to the typed agent API; happy to pair.

tara: Thanks all, I'll wait for the PR and then remove my `@ts-ignore` hacks from the repo.
